title: Implement getApiDetails Tool
description: Create tool that returns detailed information about a specific API endpoint. Must accept API id parameter, return method, path, params, rate limits, summary, handle invalid API ids gracefully, and return clear error messages.
details: Sprint 1 - API Catalog Tools. Provides detailed endpoint information.
testStrategy: Test with valid API id, invalid API id, verify all required fields in response, check error messages.
